items.en: Israeli strike kills Gaza City police chief.

items.en: Report: Iran weighs potential strikes on US targets in Europe if war escalates.

items.en: Israeli army launches series of attacks on Al-Tahir mountain range.
items.he: צה"ל פתח בסדרת תקיפות על רכס הרי אל-טאחיר.
